app.name: AarogyaVaani
onboarding.welcome: Say your medicine and the time. We’ll remind you.
onboarding.steps: Speak. Check the details. Save your reminder.
onboarding.reason: These phone settings help reminders ring at the right time.
today.emptyBody: Your saved reminders will appear here.
talk.prompt: Say a medicine and a time.
talk.example: remind me to take "My medicine" at 8 PM daily
care.title: This one is for your doctor
care.body: I can only help with reminders. Please ask your doctor or pharmacist about this.
offline.banner: No internet. Server reminders cannot be fetched or changed. This phase does not ring alarms.
offline.create: Creating a reminder needs internet in this version.
medicine.name: Medicine name
medicine.deleteBody: This removes the reminder. It does not change your treatment.
reminder.validation: Enter a medicine name and at least one time.
dose.title: Time for {{medicine}}
settings.title: Settings
settings.preview: Your reminders, clear and easy to read.
voice.unverified: Voice has not been verified in this app.
voice.network: Voice needs internet right now. You can type instead.
voice.noVoice: No voice is available for this language.
privacy.body: Typed text is sent to the project server for analysis and is not stored as chat. Confirmed medicine names, times and notes are stored there under a secure device token. No analytics. Delete removes this device data on the configured server and resets local preferences. Other server identities are unaffected. Minimum confirmed scheduling details and notification IDs are also stored on this phone. Authentication tokens remain in secure storage.
privacy.consent: Continue after reading how your data is used.
help.title: What can I say?
help.body: I only handle medicine reminders. Check the details before saving.
about.safety: This is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor, pharmacist or caregiver.
about.credits: A medicine reminder project by Kaushik Ram P and Thanishka M, VIT.

error.unsupported: I cannot understand that language yet. Please use the form.

phase.notice: Some controls on this screen are not available yet.

gallery.title: Design gallery
gallery.long: Your reminder details can wrap onto several lines. Check the medicine name and the time before saving your reminder.

api.config: Enter a valid HTTPS server origin, without a path, password or query.
api.network: Cannot connect. Check internet and the current tunnel address.
api.timeout: The server timed out. Check the connection.
api.malformed: The server returned an invalid response.
api.auth: Device authentication failed. Check the server address. Your identity was kept; do not reinstall to fix this.
api.rate: Too many requests. Wait one minute before trying again.
api.invalid: Check the reminder details and try again.
api.server: The server is unavailable. Try again later.
api.storage: Secure device storage failed. Nothing was sent with a new identity.
api.busy: An operation is already in progress.
api.uncertain: The save result is unknown. Check Medicines before entering this reminder again. Do not retry Save.
api.unsupported: This server cannot analyze the selected language or sentence. Use the reminder form.
p2.scope: Use a quoted medicine name, an exact time and daily repetition. Review before saving.
p2.offline: No internet. Server reminders cannot be fetched or changed. Check local alert status below.
p2.missing.medicine: Medicine not recognized. Correct the sentence with the medicine name.
p2.missing.time: Time is missing. Enter an explicit time with AM or PM.
p2.missing.time_ambiguous: Choose the intended time, or correct the sentence.
p2.missing.frequency: Recurrence is unclear or unsupported. Correct the sentence with daily or named weekdays.
p2.correct: Correct the sentence and check again. No reminder has been saved.
p2.manage: Select a reminder in Medicines to review its full details before deletion.
p2.serverHelp: An address change cannot transfer your identity. Use only an approved server transfer to retain reminders, history and alarms.
p2.reviewed: I checked the refreshed list. Allow a new reminder.
p3.title: Medicine reminder: {{medicine}}
p3.unknown: Local notification status has not been checked.
p3.scheduled: {{count}} local alerts scheduled through {{until}}. Delivery timing is not yet verified on this phone.
p3.denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow notifications and the Medicine reminders channel in Android Settings, then return and refresh.
p3.error: Local alert setup or cleanup failed. Alerts may be incomplete or outdated. Open notification settings and refresh before relying on them.
p3.offline: Server sync is pending or unavailable. Previously confirmed local reminders are preserved.
p3.explain: Allow notifications to receive saved medicine reminders without internet. Only confirmed reminders are scheduled. Open the app at least once every 30 days, even offline, to refill alerts. Creating, editing and cancelling server reminders requires connectivity.
p3.alarms: Exact-minute delivery is unverified. In Alarms & reminders, allow AarogyaVaani. Expo may use delayed alarms when access is off. Return to the app to rebuild alarms after changing access.
p3.limits: Battery restrictions, Do Not Disturb, force-stop and Android settings can delay or block alerts. Reopen after force-stop. Reboot delivery needs phone testing. Reminder times stay in the saved timezone; missing DST minutes are skipped and repeated minutes ring once.
p4.typeHint: Include the medicine, time and daily or selected weekdays.
p4.refill: Open the app at least every 30 days to refill local alerts.
p4.accessibilityHint: Text size, high contrast and reduced motion
p43.cached: Showing last loaded reminders. Server sync is pending.
p5.success: Text is ready. Edit it, then tap {{action}}. Saving still requires confirmation.
p5.cancelled: Voice cancelled. Your previous text is unchanged.
p5.permission: Microphone permission denied. Allow it in Android Settings or type instead.
p5.nativeMissing: Voice support is missing from this installed app. Use typing and report this before requesting a new APK.
p5.unavailable: Speech recognition is unavailable. Enable an Android speech service or type instead.
p5.language: Recognition is not configured for this language. You can still type.
p5.locale: {{language}} recognition is unavailable in the Android speech service. Check the service’s language settings or type instead.
p5.noSpeech: No speech detected. Try again or type instead.
p5.network: Voice needs internet right now. You can type instead.
p5.error: Voice recognition failed. Try again or type instead.
p5.busy: The speech service is busy. Wait or use typing.
p5.long: That spoken reminder is too long. Use 300 characters or fewer.
p5.privacy: Android’s speech service handles audio and may send it to its provider. AarogyaVaani saves no audio recordings. Only text you choose to check is sent to the reminder server.
p5.localeUnknown: This provider could not verify its language list. Recognition is being tried in {{language}}; review the text.
p5.ready: Speech language: {{language}}. Tap to dictate. Check and Save remain manual.
p5.timeout: Voice took too long. Try again or type instead.
p5.reload: The voice session did not close. Reload the app to retry voice; typing is still available.
p7.subtitle: Your medicine reminders, made simple.
p7.support: Speak naturally or type your reminder below.
p7.privacySummary: Android may send audio to its speech provider. We save no audio.
p8.local: Saved on this phone only. No server sync.
p8.error: Dose tracking could not be saved or loaded. Please refresh and try again.
p8.historyNote: History includes doses saved when Today was opened, starting with this update. Days follow this phone’s local calendar; scheduled times keep the reminder timezone. Deleted or edited reminders keep their saved history.
p8.noHistory: No saved doses for this date. This does not confirm whether medicine was taken.
p9.title: Your progress
p9.subtitle: Track your medicine routine
p9.denominator: {{taken}} taken / {{total}} saved doses · data on {{days}} of 7 days
p9.partial: Saved snapshots only; daily coverage may be incomplete.
p9.breakdown: Scheduled details retain each reminder’s timezone.
p9.explanation: Only doses saved when tracking was opened are counted, including Pending and doses scheduled later today. Missing days are unknown, never zero adherence. Edits may leave earlier snapshots; deleted reminders retain history. This is a record of your actions, not proof of consumption. Days use this phone’s current timezone; scheduled details keep the reminder’s original timezone. All records stay on this phone.
p11.settingHint: Off by default. When on, checked details and save results use the selected language when a matching local-marked device voice is available. Visual review and Save are always required.
p11.cues: Microphone start/completion sounds are best effort and depend on device sound settings. Check the visual listening status.
p11.privacy: Optional voice responses pass displayed text to your device’s TTS engine, selecting voices marked local by that engine. The engine controls voice processing; review its settings. AarogyaVaani adds no cloud voice service and stores no recordings.
p11.confirm: {{medicine}} at {{times}}, {{repeat}}. Please check the details before saving.
p11.missingTime: I couldn’t confirm the time. Please check your reminder.
p11.clarify: Please check the missing details before saving.
p11.saveFailed: I couldn’t save your reminder. Please try again.
p11.saveUncertain: I couldn’t confirm whether your reminder was saved. Check Medicines before trying again.
p11.checkFailed: I couldn’t check your reminder. Please try again when connected.
p11.nativeMissing: Voice responses are unavailable in this installed build. You can still check and save visually.
p11.language: No {{language}} device voice was found. Check Android TTS language data; continue with the displayed details.
p11.localVoice: Could not identify a local-marked {{language}} voice. No fallback language was spoken; use the displayed details.
p11.error: Voice response could not play. Your reminder details remain on screen.
p11.stopFailed: Audio stop is not confirmed. Retry the microphone, or type instead. Capture waits for audio to stop.
p112.cue.nativeMissing: Microphone sounds need an updated app build. Use the visual listening status.
p112.cue.error: Microphone sound could not play. Use the visual listening status.
p11.microphoneInterrupted: Microphone did not start because audio handoff was interrupted. Return to Talk and try again or type.
p12.dismissHint: Closing or snoozing leaves this dose Pending. Only Taken or Skip changes your record.
p12.error: This reminder could not be opened or the action could not be completed. Check Today or History before trying again. Your saved records are kept.
p12.headsUp: Reminders use a high-importance notification channel. Android may show a heads-up alert, depending on your notification settings, lock screen, silent mode and Do Not Disturb. Tap a notification to open its scheduled dose.
p12.soundHint: These choices apply to future and pending alerts and are separate from microphone beeps. Android channel settings take priority. Silent channels may not show heads-up alerts. Changing a choice selects its notification channel; a blocked medicine channel stays blocked. Open Android notification settings to adjust an existing channel.
p12.fullScreenExplain: Optional full-screen reminders could open over the lock screen for an eligible, permitted alarm. They require Android permission, a native implementation and a reviewed Google Play use case. They must never bypass device restrictions.
p12.fullScreenUnavailable: Off — unavailable in this build. Full-screen eligibility has not been established for this medicine reminder app. Standard notifications remain in use; heads-up display is subject to Android settings.
p12.unconfirmedSnooze: A snoozed alert could not be confirmed before its scheduled time. Check Today or History. Open the original notification to snooze again if needed.
p2.missing.dosage: Dosage instructions need manual review. Use the form and follow your prescription; no dose was inferred.
p13.pattern: Use a quoted medicine name, an exact time and daily repetition. Review before saving.
p132.voiceHelp: In Android Settings, open Languages & input → Text-to-speech output. In your preferred engine settings, install or download voice data for the selected language. Menu names vary by phone. Typing and microphone Talk remain available.
api.cutover: This address needs an approved identity transfer. Your existing identity is unchanged.
p14.confirm: Continue only after both servers are frozen and their migrated records have been verified. Tokens, local history and alarm namespaces will be retained.
p14.done: Server transfer saved. Existing identity and local scopes retained.
